pages.lesson:
LESSON: SQUARES AND SQUARE ROOTS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.4: Squares and Square roots

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Squares and Square roots. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are squares and square roots of numbers?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. work out the squares of numbers from tables in different situations
2. work out the square roots of numbers from tables in different situations
3. work out squares and square roots of numbers using a calculator in different situations

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Squares and Square roots.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Squares and Square roots using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read and write the squares of numbers from tables,
2. Read and write the square roots of numbers from tables,
3. Practice working out squares and square roots using a calculator,
4. Use IT devices or other materials to play square and square root games,
5. Communication and Collaboration: as the learner works with peers to read and write the square roots of numbers from tables.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are squares and square roots of numbers?
2. Where do we apply squares and square roots in real-life situations?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Squares and Square roots is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
